nodes.name: linear_native.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the native Linear API integration used by in-app Linear project/issue management commands; declares the cache/input/parse/queries/service/types submodules and re-exports the public service functions and wire types.

nodes.name: input.rs
nodes.summary: Builds Linear GraphQL mutation input JSON objects (project/workflow-state/issue create & update) from typed request structs, validating required fields and mapping optional fields into the GraphQL input shape.

nodes.name: parse.rs
nodes.summary: Parses raw Linear GraphQL JSON responses into typed result structs (projects, teams, workflow states, issues) with the field-extraction helpers used throughout the native Linear service layer.

nodes.name: service.rs
nodes.summary: Service layer for native Linear project/team/workflow-state/issue CRUD, resolving a bearer token via the connection store and OAuth refresh, executing cached or live GraphQL calls through LinearClient, and building/parsing each request.

nodes.name: metrics.rs
nodes.summary: Append-only JSON-Lines telemetry log for the sync subsystem: every push/pull/webhook/import/conflict-resolve operation records a SyncMetric line to ~/.orgii/sync-metrics.jsonl, with size-based rotation to a single .1 backup for recent-window support triage.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately favors an append-only JSONL file with aggressive rotation over long-term observability storage, trading history depth for write simplicity.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root barrel module for the pluggable sync framework, declaring all sync submodules (types, io, adapter, adapters, worker, oauth, webhook_listener, etc.) and re-exporting their public API for the rest of the crate.

nodes.name: project_create_input
nodes.summary: Builds the GraphQL input object for a Linear project-create mutation, validating the project name and required team ids.

nodes.name: project_update_input
nodes.summary: Builds the GraphQL input object for a Linear project-update mutation.

nodes.name: workflow_state_create_input
nodes.summary: Builds the GraphQL input object for a Linear workflow-state-create mutation.

nodes.name: workflow_state_update_input
nodes.summary: Builds the GraphQL input object for a Linear workflow-state-update mutation.

nodes.name: issue_create_input
nodes.summary: Builds the GraphQL input object for a Linear issue-create mutation.

nodes.name: issue_update_input
nodes.summary: Builds the GraphQL input object for a Linear issue-update mutation.

nodes.name: parse_project_list
nodes.summary: Parses a Linear GraphQL projects-list response page into a typed LinearProjectListResult.

nodes.name: parse_team_list
nodes.summary: Parses a Linear GraphQL teams-list response page into a typed LinearTeamListResult.

nodes.name: parse_workflow_state_list
nodes.summary: Parses a Linear GraphQL workflow-states response page into a typed result.

nodes.name: parse_issue_list
nodes.summary: Parses a Linear GraphQL issues-list response page into a typed LinearIssueListResult.

nodes.name: parse_project
nodes.summary: Parses a single Linear project JSON node into a LinearProjectSummary.

nodes.name: parse_workflow_state
nodes.summary: Parses a single Linear workflow-state JSON node into a LinearWorkflowStateSummary.

nodes.name: parse_issue
nodes.summary: Parses a single Linear issue JSON node into a LinearIssueSummary.

nodes.name: parse_success
nodes.summary: Parses a Linear mutation success acknowledgement, erroring if the mutation reported failure.

nodes.name: bearer_for_linear_connection
nodes.summary: Resolves a fresh OAuth bearer token (or PAT) for a Linear sync connection.

nodes.name: list_projects
nodes.summary: Lists Linear projects for a connection, serving from cache unless force_refresh is set.

nodes.name: get_project
nodes.summary: Fetches a single Linear project by id.

nodes.name: list_teams
nodes.summary: Lists Linear teams for a connection.

nodes.name: list_workflow_states
nodes.summary: Lists workflow states for a Linear team.

nodes.name: create_workflow_state
nodes.summary: Creates a new Linear workflow state via GraphQL mutation.

nodes.name: update_workflow_state
nodes.summary: Updates an existing Linear workflow state.

nodes.name: archive_workflow_state
nodes.summary: Archives a Linear workflow state.

nodes.name: create_project
nodes.summary: Creates a new Linear project via GraphQL mutation.

nodes.name: update_project
nodes.summary: Updates an existing Linear project.

nodes.name: archive_project
nodes.summary: Archives a Linear project.

nodes.name: list_project_issues
nodes.summary: Lists issues belonging to a Linear project.

nodes.name: create_issue
nodes.summary: Creates a new Linear issue via GraphQL mutation.

nodes.name: update_issue
nodes.summary: Updates an existing Linear issue.

nodes.name: archive_issue
nodes.summary: Archives a Linear issue.

nodes.name: MetricKind
nodes.summary: Enum of sync operation kinds recorded to the metrics log: Push, Pull, Webhook, Import, ConflictResolve.

nodes.name: MetricOutcome
nodes.summary: Enum of sync operation outcomes: Ok, Empty, Transient, Permanent, Auth, RateLimited, Cancelled, Skipped.

nodes.name: SyncMetric
nodes.summary: One JSON-Lines log record: timestamp, project slug, adapter, kind, outcome, duration, count, optional note.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends a SyncMetric line to the log file, rotating to a .1 backup once the file exceeds the size cap.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that builds and appends a SyncMetric for an operation outcome.

nodes.name: record_with_note
nodes.summary: Like record but attaches a free-text note (e.g. an error message) to the metric.

nodes.name: maybe_rotate
nodes.summary: Renames the active log to its .1 backup once it exceeds MAX_LOG_BYTES, discarding any older backup.

nodes.name: tail
nodes.summary: Reads the most recent N metric lines across the active file and its .1 backup for the support-triage UI.
